heroHeadline: Hanging decor handmade in Howrah, supplied in bulk across India
heroIntro: JHALAR makes decorative hangings by hand in Howrah, West Bengal. We supply pom pom garlands, floral jhalars, bell hangings, torans and tassels to event teams, retailers and wholesalers across India.
siteTitle: JHALAR Hanging Decor | Made in Howrah, Bulk Supply Across India
siteDescription: Handmade decorative hangings from Howrah, India: pom pom garlands, floral jhalars, bell hangings, torans and tassels. Bulk supply for events, retailers and wholesalers across India.

faqItems.q: Do you supply decorative hangings in bulk?
faqItems.a: Yes. We are set up for bulk supply to event decorators, wholesalers and retailers. Tell us the category and quantity and we will confirm availability and pricing.

faqItems.q: Can you make custom colours and designs?
faqItems.a: Yes. For suitable order quantities we can match your palette and build to your design. Share a reference image or colour codes and we will advise what is possible.

faqItems.q: What is your typical lead time?
faqItems.a: Lead time depends on quantity and design. Standard pieces usually ship faster than custom work. We will confirm a realistic timeline when you share your requirement.
Yes. We dispatch to most states across India. Freight is calculated on the destination and order weight, and we share the total before you confirm.

faqItems.q: How do I get a quotation?
faqItems.a: Send the item, quantity and any custom notes through the enquiry form or WhatsApp. We reply with pricing, availability and a dispatch estimate.

faqItems.q: Do you work with wholesalers and distributors?
faqItems.a: Yes. We supply wholesalers and distributors. Share your business details and expected volumes and we will outline wholesale terms.

faqItems.q: Do you provide an invoice with GST?
faqItems.a: Yes. We issue a GST invoice with every order. GST registration details are available on request.
